dsr_proxy.method: rough proxy using train/oos selection dispersion and sqrt(2 ln N)

sample_data_caveats: Uses Alpaca IEX feed, not consolidated SIP.
Longer validation window still covers less than one full trading year.
No cross-source confirmation against Longbridge/SIP-equivalent data yet.
capacity_assessment: No ADV participation calculation yet. Target-weight mapping caps gross exposure at 0.12 in the observation artifact, but broker shortability, borrow, squeeze, and dividend evidence are still required before paper automation.
notes: Short-window 2026-02-02 to 2026-05-22 validation produced high OOS metrics, but longer 2025-11-03 to 2026-05-22 validation failed: OOS annualized return -27.10%, OOS Sharpe -1.32, OOS equal-weight alpha -161.26%, and only 2 of 5 walk-forward folds positive. Treat as research candidate only, not paper-ready.
